text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 - canary error rate spike for inference-api/canary in us-west. 5xx rate ↑ from 0.3% -> 12% over 5m. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/inference/canary-5xx
oliver: I'm oncall, taking this. how big is the canary? any customer impact?
alice: rolled model-serving v2 to 10% canary ~10m ago. I just noticed errors in the dashboard.
ben: looking now — HPA for inference-canary scaled down replicas from 5 -> 1 in last 6m. kube events show scaling decision to 1.
carmen: support queue: 12 customers filed 500s in the last 8m. topology shows errors concentrated on us-west canary endpoints.
ben: logs from one pod: CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled on cold start. But requests spiked, with only 1 replica we hit OOM under burst.
alice: digging into the chart I templated: the autoscaler target metric key got removed by a values merge bug (we dropped the custom.metrics name). HPA fell back to default behavior -> underprovisioned.
sam: there was also a scheduled node drain in us-west initiated ~7m ago for infra maintenance. combined with HPA downscale -> very little capacity.
oliver: immediate mitigation: stop canary traffic and revert rollout. @alice flip the flag or rollback the rollout. also bump HPA minReplicas while we stabilize.
alice: flipping feature flag now. running: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-canary && kubectl patch hpa inference-canary -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated for deployment/inference-canary by alice at 6212345735.
incident-bot: Traffic shift: canary -> stable 100% complete (svc routing updated).
ben: patch applied, minReplicas=3. new pods coming up. monitoring pod startup logs; initial pods look healthy.
carmen: support: sending notification to affected customers. prepping template for status update.
liz: sending out the customer-facing note now — will escalate to SEs for customers showing errors.
ben: postmortem notes: root cause = templating bug removed HPA metric/annotation so autoscaler made an unsafe decision. contributing factor = coincident node drain that reduced capacity. outcome = canary underprovisioned -> OOMs -> increased 5xx for 10% traffic.
alice: action items I will own: revert template change, add unit test in chart CI that asserts autoscaler metric key is preserved, and add a pre-rollout check to ensure HPA replica >= min threshold.
ben: SRE action: add a rollout guard to block traffic shift if HPA replicas < 2 for canaries, and add an alert that fires when HPA decisions drop replicas >50% in 10m.
sam: infra will reschedule node maintenance windows and avoid overlap with canary rollouts for 24h.
oliver: status: services stable, error rate back to baseline. keep monitoring 30m. if anything regresses page me immediately. :white_check_mark:
carmen: also propose adding a canary health gate: block rollout if error rate >1% or latency >2s for >3m.
liz: customers contacted, a small number saw degraded service but no data loss. logging ticket numbers for followup.
alice: temporary mitigation done; I'll file the PRs and tests after handoff.
oliver: handing to eng oncall for followup. thx all. :rotating_light:
